title: Zekra: AI Second Brain
shortDescription: Notes and memory you share with Claude, ChatGPT and your AI agents.
fullDescription:
Zekra is a second brain you share with your AI agents.

Everything you write down — and everything your agents learn — goes into a brain: a private, searchable memory that Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client can recall. What one conversation learns, the next one already knows.

NOTES THAT REMEMBER
• Write in a fast Markdown editor with checklists, tables, images and links.
• Pin, archive and organise notes into brains for each project or part of your life.
• Every note is linked into a knowledge graph, so related ideas surface together.

RECALL, NOT JUST SEARCH
• Hybrid search finds both meaning and exact names: ask in your own words.
• Recall works across languages.
• Memories strengthen as you use them, and you can correct them at any time.

YOUR AGENTS, CONNECTED
• Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex or Gemini to your brain over MCP.
• Agents retain what they learn as notes you can read and edit.
• Each brain is shared per agent and per person, with scoped access.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Passwords and keys pasted into a note move into an encrypted Vault.
• Share a presentation by private link and revoke it whenever you like.

PRESENTATIONS FROM WHAT YOU KNOW
• Turn notes or a whole brain into a deck, report or page.
• Export to PDF or Word.

Zekra is open source. Sign in with your Zekra account, or connect your own Zekra server.
